descriptionChirho: A proper name referring primarily to the Levitical musician and singer appointed by David, son of Joel and grandson of Samuel, head of one of the three temple music guilds (1 Chronicles 6, 15, 16, 25; 2 Chronicles 5, 29, 35). Also the Ezrahite sage mentioned alongside Ethan in 1 Kings 5:11 (Eng 4:31) and the Psalm 88 superscription. All 17 occurrences share the same name form regardless of prefix (and, of, to). Eng 'Heman', spa 'Heman', hin 'Heman', arb 'Hayman', kor 'Heman', swa 'Hemani'.
